原文与作答 · 分开滚动

原文第7段For these reasons, the sensationalism over AI has attracted many critics. Stuart Russell, a professor of computer science at the University of California, Berkeley, has long advocated a more sensible and realistic approach that focuses on simple everyday applications of AI instead of the hypothetical takeover by super-intelligent robots. Similarly, Rodney Brooks, professor of robotics at Massachusetts Institute of Technology, writes that 'almost all innovations in robotics and AI take far, far, longer to be really widely deployed than people in the field and outside the field imagine'.

原文第8段One of the many difficulties in deploying machine learning systems is that AI is extremely susceptible to adversarial attacks. This means that a malicious AI can target another AI to make it behave in a certain way, such as forcing it to make wrong predictions. Many researchers have warned against the rolling out of AI without appropriate security standards and defence mechanisms. Still, AI security remains an often overlooked topic when machine learning systems are installed.

原文第9段If we are to reap the benefits and minimise the potential harms of AI, we must start thinking about how machine learning can be meaningfully applied to specific areas of government, business and society. This means we need to have a discussion about AI ethics and the distrust that many people have towards machine learning.

原文第10段Most importantly, we need to be aware of the limitations of AI and where people still need to take the lead. Instead of painting an unrealistic picture of the power of AI, it is important to take a step back and separate the actual technological capabilities of AI from fantasy.

原文第11段The medical profession has also recognised the drawbacks to AI. The IBM Watson for Oncology programme was a piece of AI that was meant to help doctors treat cancer. Even though it was developed to deliver the best recommendations, human experts found it hard to trust the machine. As a result, the AI programme was abandoned in most hospitals where it was trialled.

原文第12段Similar difficulties arose in the legal domain when algorithms were used in courts in the US to sentence criminals. An algorithm calculated risk assessment scores and advised judges on the sentencing. The system was found to amplify structural racial discrimination and was later abandoned.

原文第13段There are some crucial lessons here for everyone aiming to boost investments in national AI programmes. These examples demonstrate that there is no AI solution for everything. Using AI simply for the sake of AI may not always be productive or useful, and not every issue is best addressed by applying machine intelligence to it. All solutions come with a cost and not everything that can be automated should be.

题目与作答

Q36–39：YES / NO / NOT GIVEN。Q34–35：选词摘要填空，完整选项A–I保留。按原文顺序编排本段题组，原题号不变。全篇主旨Q40需阅读全文，未列入裁切。

共用选项 · 原题 34、35

  • A reliability
  • B funding
  • C skills
  • D prejudices
  • E computers
  • F equality
  • G framework
  • H confidentiality
  • I approval

36. Stuart Russell's proposals regarding the use of AI are impractical.

37. Rodney Brooks' view has attracted unfair criticism from supporters of AI.

38. Nowadays, the need to protect AI systems is always taken into account when they are set up.

39. In order to benefit from AI and minimise the harms, we have to explore people's concerns about its use.

34. The medical profession experimented with an AI programme, but their experts had little faith in its 34 __________, and the programme was abandoned.

35. US courts also abandoned the use of algorithms when it was found that these reflected and magnified the existing 35 __________ within the legal profession.

对照答案，回到证据

第 36 题 · NO

作者赞成sensible and realistic，明确与impractical相反；无需评价Russell现实成就。

a more sensible and realistic approach that focuses on simple everyday applications of AI

第 37 题 · NOT GIVEN

全文只引用Brooks对部署耗时的判断，没有支持者如何回应他的观点，unfair更无依据。

almost all innovations in robotics and AI take far, far, longer to be really widely deployed

第 38 题 · NO

often overlooked直接反驳always taken into account；不是只缺少资料。

AI security remains an often overlooked topic when machine learning systems are installed

第 39 题 · YES

concerns概括ethics与distrust；need to have a discussion支持have to explore。

we need to have a discussion about AI ethics and the distrust that many people have towards machine learning

第 34 题 · A

hard to trust是对reliability的信任不足；不是缺钱funding。

human experts found it hard to trust the machine

第 35 题 · D

amplify对应magnified，racial discrimination对应prejudices；没有说系统只缺技能。

The system was found to amplify structural racial discrimination

核对原答案页

材料精读 · 内容与词句

后半篇从专家对宣传的批评转向安全、伦理与实际用途，再用医疗和司法例子说明部署限制，最后提出有选择地使用AI。作者要求把收益、潜在伤害和人的职责一并考虑，并未主张一律停止技术应用。具体项目经历均按本文叙述理解，不作为当前项目状态的独立核验。

原文第7段

For these reasons, the sensationalism over AI has attracted many critics. Stuart Russell, a professor of computer science at the University of California, Berkeley, has long advocated a more sensible and realistic approach that focuses on simple everyday applications of AI instead of the hypothetical takeover by super-intelligent robots. Similarly, Rodney Brooks, professor of robotics at Massachusetts Institute of Technology, writes that 'almost all innovations in robotics and AI take far, far, longer to be really widely deployed than people in the field and outside the field imagine'.

第7段承接前面关于实施困难的讨论，介绍两位研究者的观点：关注日常具体用途，并对广泛部署需要的时间保持现实认识。Brooks的引语谈“几乎所有创新”所需时间比想象长，不是说所有创新最终都会成功或永远无法部署。

原文第8段

One of the many difficulties in deploying machine learning systems is that AI is extremely susceptible to adversarial attacks. This means that a malicious AI can target another AI to make it behave in a certain way, such as forcing it to make wrong predictions. Many researchers have warned against the rolling out of AI without appropriate security standards and defence mechanisms. Still, AI security remains an often overlooked topic when machine learning systems are installed.

第8段解释对抗性攻击及相关安全问题：恶意AI可能使另一系统作出错误预测。研究者据此警告，在缺乏适当安全标准与防御机制时不应贸然推广。Still将已有警告与安全仍常被忽视的情况并置。

原文第9段

If we are to reap the benefits and minimise the potential harms of AI, we must start thinking about how machine learning can be meaningfully applied to specific areas of government, business and society. This means we need to have a discussion about AI ethics and the distrust that many people have towards machine learning.

第9段以“获得收益并减少潜在伤害”为目标，要求讨论AI在具体领域如何有意义地应用，同时考虑伦理和人们的不信任。meaningfully强调解决实际需要，而不是仅仅把技术放进某个场景。

原文第10段

Most importantly, we need to be aware of the limitations of AI and where people still need to take the lead. Instead of painting an unrealistic picture of the power of AI, it is important to take a step back and separate the actual technological capabilities of AI from fantasy.

第10段进一步强调认识能力边界与人仍应主导的地方。take a step back是暂退一步冷静审视的比喻；separate...from...要求区分实际能力与幻想，不是说AI完全没有能力。

原文第11段

The medical profession has also recognised the drawbacks to AI. The IBM Watson for Oncology programme was a piece of AI that was meant to help doctors treat cancer. Even though it was developed to deliver the best recommendations, human experts found it hard to trust the machine. As a result, the AI programme was abandoned in most hospitals where it was trialled.

第11段按本文叙述，以Watson肿瘤项目说明“设计上希望给出最佳建议”与“使用者实际建立信任”之间的距离。was meant to、developed to都表达目的，不能读成已经证实可靠。most hospitals where it was trialled限定为文中试用该项目的多数医院，不是所有医院或所有医疗AI。

原文第12段

Similar difficulties arose in the legal domain when algorithms were used in courts in the US to sentence criminals. An algorithm calculated risk assessment scores and advised judges on the sentencing. The system was found to amplify structural racial discrimination and was later abandoned.

第12段按本文叙述，写一个在美国法院辅助量刑的算法放大结构性种族歧视并被弃用的例子。该段具体说明技术建议可能带来的社会后果；不能从这一系统的经历推出所有司法算法都有同一结果。

原文第13段

There are some crucial lessons here for everyone aiming to boost investments in national AI programmes. These examples demonstrate that there is no AI solution for everything. Using AI simply for the sake of AI may not always be productive or useful, and not every issue is best addressed by applying machine intelligence to it. All solutions come with a cost and not everything that can be automated should be.

第13段把前面的例子收束为选择使用范围的原则：技术本身不是使用理由，自动化也有成本，并非所有可以自动化的事都应该自动化。may not always与not every都是否定普遍保证，而不是断言AI在任何场景都无用。

词语与搭配

widely deployed

得到广泛部署

deploy在技术语境中指投入使用；widely描述应用范围，不能与实验成功或刚开发出来混同。

appropriate security standards

适当的安全标准

appropriate强调与用途和风险相符的标准；有标准仍不自动意味着风险为零。

minimise the potential harms

尽量减少潜在伤害

minimise指尽量降低，potential表示可能发生；两者都不同于保证完全消除伤害。

be aware of the limitations of

认识到……的局限

limitations常接of说明对象；意识到局限可以帮助确定适用范围，不等于完全拒绝使用。

simply for the sake of AI

仅仅为了使用AI本身

for the sake of可表示目的或理由；simply在这里批评没有实际需要支撑的技术采用。

句子精读

If we are to reap the benefits and minimise the potential harms of AI, we must start thinking about how machine learning can be meaningfully applied to specific areas of government, business and society.

如果我们要获得AI的益处并尽量减少其潜在伤害，就必须开始思考机器学习怎样才能有意义地应用到政府、企业和社会的具体领域。

If we are to...表达想实现的目标，must...提出作者认为必要的行动。reap与minimise并列，收益和伤害同时受到关注；how从句说明需要思考的是应用方式，specific areas限制讨论到具体领域。

Using AI simply for the sake of AI may not always be productive or useful, and not every issue is best addressed by applying machine intelligence to it.

仅仅为了使用AI而使用AI，未必总是有成效或有用；也并非每个问题都最适合通过应用机器智能来处理。

Using AI...是动名词主语；may not always保留“并非总是”的范围。not every issue是部分否定，不等于no issue。by applying...说明处理方式，it回指issue。

这篇材料里可用于写作的表达

minimise the potential harms

尽量减少潜在伤害

适合与审查、监管和试验条件相连；不能声称审查可以保证消除全部风险。

用于写作：自编例句，直接回应科研应如何受到控制：提出可适用于公共和私营实验室的审查安排，不把监管等同于政府独占所有研究。

be aware of the limitations of

认识到……的局限

后接具体技术或方法；认识边界服务于判断用途，避免演变成空泛反科技态度。

用于写作：自编例句，贴合政府科研监督职责，把能力边界与是否批准扩大应用联系起来。

读完讲解，可以把原文连起来再读一次；想保留的词句可使用已有收藏功能。
Older workers：薪资条件与两种继续工作的动机未作答选择题 · 4 段 · 412 词 · 4 题

官方样题 · IELTS.org Academic Reading Sample Tasks 2023 · Older workers · Q1–4 · PDF 第 1, 2 页

原文与作答 · 分开滚动

1The general assumption is that older workers are paid more in spite of, rather than because of, their productivity. That might partly explain why, when employers are under pressure to cut costs, they persuade a 55-year old to take early retirement. Take away seniority-based pay scales, and older workers may become a much more attractive employment proposition. But most employers and many workers are uncomfortable with the idea of reducing someone’s pay in later life – although manual workers on piece-rates often earn less as they get older. So retaining the services of older workers may mean employing them in different ways.

2One innovation was devised by IBM Belgium. Faced with the need to cut staff costs, and having decided to concentrate cuts on 55 to 60-year olds, IBM set up a separate company called Skill Team, which re-employed any of the early retired who wanted to go on working up to the age of 60. An employee who joined Skill Team at the age of 55 on a five-year contract would work for 58% of his time, over the full period, for 88% of his last IBM salary. The company offered services to IBM, thus allowing it to retain access to some of the intellectual capital it would otherwise have lost.

3The best way to tempt the old to go on working may be to build on such ‘bridge’ jobs: part- time or temporary employment that creates a more gradual transition from full-time work to retirement. Studies have found that, in the United States, nearly half of all men and women who had been in full-time jobs in middle age moved into such ‘bridge’ jobs at the end of their working lives. In general, it is the best-paid and worst-paid who carry on working. There seem to be two very different types of bridge job-holder – those who continue working because they have to and those who continue working because they want to, even though they could afford to retire.

4If the job market grows more flexible, the old may find more jobs that suit them. Often, they will be self-employed. Sometimes, they may start their own businesses: a study by David Storey of Warwick University found that in Britain 70% of businesses started by people over 55 survived, compared with an overall national average of only 19%. But whatever pattern of employment they choose, in the coming years the skills of these ‘grey workers’ will have to be increasingly acknowledged and rewarded.

题目与作答

Choose the correct letter, A, B, C or D. Write the correct letter in boxes 1–4.

1. In paragraph one, the writer suggests that companies could consider

  • A. abolishing pay schemes that are based on age.
  • B. avoiding pay that is based on piece-rates.
  • C. increasing pay for older workers.
  • D. equipping older workers with new skills.

2. Skill Team is an example of a company which

  • A. offers older workers increases in salary.
  • B. allows people to continue working for as long as they want.
  • C. allows the expertise of older workers to be put to use.
  • D. treats older and younger workers equally.

3. According to the writer, ‘bridge’ jobs

  • A. tend to attract people in middle-salary ranges.
  • B. are better paid than some full-time jobs.
  • C. originated in the United States.
  • D. appeal to distinct groups of older workers.

4. David Storey’s study found that

  • A. people demand more from their work as they get older.
  • B. older people are good at running their own businesses.
  • C. an increasing number of old people are self-employed.
  • D. few young people have their own businesses.

对照答案，回到证据

第 1 题 · A

建议取消按资历定薪的制度。piece-rates只用作反例，不是作者建议废除它。

Take away seniority-based pay scales, and older workers may become a much more attractive employment proposition.

第 2 题 · C

保留经验和知识正对应expertise。88%不是加薪，工作到60岁不是想多久就多久。

thus allowing it to retain access to some of the intellectual capital it would otherwise have lost.

第 3 题 · D

两类人的动机不同，D概括distinct groups。美国研究发生地不能推出起源于美国，最佳和最差薪酬者也不等于中间薪资。

those who continue working because they have to and those who continue working because they want to

第 4 题 · B

较高企业存活比例支持经营表现，未给自雇人数随时间增多趋势或年轻人拥有企业的比例。

70% of businesses started by people over 55 survived, compared with an overall national average of only 19%.

核对原答案页

材料精读 · 内容与词句

文章讨论怎样保留年长劳动者的经验。先提出薪资和成本之间的矛盾，再用公司安排说明替代雇用方式，随后解释渐进退休的不同动机，最后展望更灵活的就业形式。文中的研究数字属于材料所述研究，不能外推为当前各国的普遍比例。

1

The general assumption is that older workers are paid more in spite of, rather than because of, their productivity. That might partly explain why, when employers are under pressure to cut costs, they persuade a 55-year old to take early retirement. Take away seniority-based pay scales, and older workers may become a much more attractive employment proposition. But most employers and many workers are uncomfortable with the idea of reducing someone’s pay in later life – although manual workers on piece-rates often earn less as they get older. So retaining the services of older workers may mean employing them in different ways.

第1段先报告一种常见假设：年长者收入较高未必由生产率解释。might partly把它限制为雇主推动提前退休的部分可能原因。取消按资历加薪或降低晚年薪酬并非没有阻力，因此段末转向改变雇用方式，而不是简单地要求降薪。

2

One innovation was devised by IBM Belgium. Faced with the need to cut staff costs, and having decided to concentrate cuts on 55 to 60-year olds, IBM set up a separate company called Skill Team, which re-employed any of the early retired who wanted to go on working up to the age of 60. An employee who joined Skill Team at the age of 55 on a five-year contract would work for 58% of his time, over the full period, for 88% of his last IBM salary. The company offered services to IBM, thus allowing it to retain access to some of the intellectual capital it would otherwise have lost.

第2段以IBM Belgium的Skill Team安排具体化这种改变：部分提前退休者通过另设公司继续工作；文中五年合同的58%工时和88%原薪酬是这一安排的条件。服务继续提供给IBM，使它保留本来可能流失的知识经验。

3

The best way to tempt the old to go on working may be to build on such ‘bridge’ jobs: part- time or temporary employment that creates a more gradual transition from full-time work to retirement. Studies have found that, in the United States, nearly half of all men and women who had been in full-time jobs in middle age moved into such ‘bridge’ jobs at the end of their working lives. In general, it is the best-paid and worst-paid who carry on working. There seem to be two very different types of bridge job-holder – those who continue working because they have to and those who continue working because they want to, even though they could afford to retire.

第3段把个案扩展到“桥梁工作”，即帮助人从全职工作逐步过渡到退休的兼职或临时工作。继续工作的人包括收入较高和较低的两端，背后可能分别是愿意工作和必须维持收入；两者不能混为同一种选择。

4

If the job market grows more flexible, the old may find more jobs that suit them. Often, they will be self-employed. Sometimes, they may start their own businesses: a study by David Storey of Warwick University found that in Britain 70% of businesses started by people over 55 survived, compared with an overall national average of only 19%. But whatever pattern of employment they choose, in the coming years the skills of these ‘grey workers’ will have to be increasingly acknowledged and rewarded.

第4段用条件句讨论更灵活的市场可能带来的机会，包括自雇和创业。英国特定研究中的企业存活比例用于支撑年长创业者可能拥有的能力，不等于他们在所有条件下都更成功。结尾强调无论采用何种形式，其技能都需要被承认并获得回报。

词语与搭配

under pressure to cut costs

承受削减成本的压力

under pressure to后接动作，说明压力指向什么；不等于已经完成削减。

retain access to

保留获得或使用……的渠道

retain强调继续拥有；文中指IBM仍能利用原员工的知识，不是把这些人视作公司所有物。

a more gradual transition

更为逐步的过渡

transition常与from...to...连接起点和终点；gradual描述过程速度，不自动等于对每个人都更合适。

could afford to retire

在经济上能够承担退休

afford to指具备承受某种选择的资源；此处与因经济需要必须继续工作的人形成区别。

句子精读

Faced with the need to cut staff costs, and having decided to concentrate cuts on 55 to 60-year olds, IBM set up a separate company called Skill Team, which re-employed any of the early retired who wanted to go on working up to the age of 60.

IBM面对削减员工成本的需要，并且已经决定把削减集中在55至60岁员工身上，于是设立了名为Skill Team的独立公司，重新雇用那些提前退休后仍希望继续工作到60岁的人。

Faced with...和having decided...共同补充IBM的背景，后者表示先作出的决定；which指Skill Team。who限定愿意继续工作的提前退休者，并非所有提前退休员工都会自动加入。

There seem to be two very different types of bridge job-holder – those who continue working because they have to and those who continue working because they want to, even though they could afford to retire.

桥梁工作从业者似乎有两种很不相同的类型：一类因为不得不工作而继续，另一类即使经济上能够退休，也因为自己愿意而继续工作。

There seem to be保留概括的审慎程度；两个those who...并列。have to与want to区分必要性和意愿，even though引出第二类人的让步条件。

读完讲解，可以把原文连起来再读一次；想保留的词句可使用已有收藏功能。

官方样题 · Cambridge Academic Reading official sample · Dung beetles · PDF 第 1, 2 页

与蜣螂图示组共用同一篇完整原文；这是原题Q9–13的另一种信息组织方式。

原文与作答 · 分开滚动

1Introducing dung beetles into a pasture is a simple process: approximately 1,500 beetles are released, a handful at a time, into fresh cow pats in the cow pasture. The beetles immediately disappear beneath the pats digging and tunnelling and, if they successfully adapt to their new environment, soon become a permanent, self-sustaining part of the local ecology. In time they multiply and within three or four years the benefits to the pasture are obvious.

2Dung beetles work from the inside of the pat so they are sheltered from predators such as birds and foxes. Most species burrow into the soil and bury dung in tunnels directly underneath the pats, which are hollowed out from within. Some large species originating from France excavate tunnels to a depth of approximately 30 cm below the dung pat. These beetles make sausage-shaped brood chambers along the tunnels. The shallowest tunnels belong to a much smaller Spanish species that buries dung in chambers that hang like fruit from the branches of a pear tree. South African beetles dig narrow tunnels of approximately 20 cm below the surface of the pat. Some surface-dwelling beetles, including a South African species, cut perfectly-shaped balls from the pat, which are rolled away and attached to the bases of plants.

3For maximum dung burial in spring, summer and autumn, farmers require a variety of species with overlapping periods of activity. In the cooler environments of the state of Victoria, the large French species (2.5 cms long), is matched with smaller (half this size), temperate-climate Spanish species. The former are slow to recover from the winter cold and produce only one or two generations of offspring from late spring until autumn. The latter, which multiply rapidly in early spring, produce two to five generations annually. The South African ball-rolling species, being a sub-tropical beetle, prefers the climate of northern and coastal New South Wales where it commonly works with the South African tunneling species. In warmer climates, many species are active for longer periods of the year.

原题 Glossary：dung — the droppings or excreta of animals

原题 Glossary：cow pats — droppings of cows

题目与作答

Complete the table below. Choose NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS from the passage for each answer. Write your answers in boxes 9–13. 原表保留行列及已给数据。

9. Spanish → Preferred climate → 9 …

10. Spanish → Start of active period → 10 …

11. Spanish → Number of generations per year → 11 …

12. South African ball roller → Preferred climate → 12 …

13. South African ball roller → Complementary species → 13 …

对照答案，回到证据

第 9 题 · temperate

Spanish行气候列；cool在示例French行，不能横向抄错。

第 10 题 · early spring

这段材料围绕蜣螂在牧场中的作用展开。大小、隧道形状、繁殖速度与活动季节共同解释不同物种为何能够配合；这些特点必须放回各自物种和气候条件中理解。

1

Introducing dung beetles into a pasture is a simple process: approximately 1,500 beetles are released, a handful at a time, into fresh cow pats in the cow pasture. The beetles immediately disappear beneath the pats digging and tunnelling and, if they successfully adapt to their new environment, soon become a permanent, self-sustaining part of the local ecology. In time they multiply and within three or four years the benefits to the pasture are obvious.

第1段说明引入过程及建立种群的条件：把甲虫少量分批放入新鲜牛粪后，它们会向下挖掘；只有成功适应新环境，才会形成能自行维持的本地生态组成。三四年后收益明显是文中描述的时间尺度，不能略去适应条件。

2

Dung beetles work from the inside of the pat so they are sheltered from predators such as birds and foxes. Most species burrow into the soil and bury dung in tunnels directly underneath the pats, which are hollowed out from within. Some large species originating from France excavate tunnels to a depth of approximately 30 cm below the dung pat. These beetles make sausage-shaped brood chambers along the tunnels. The shallowest tunnels belong to a much smaller Spanish species that buries dung in chambers that hang like fruit from the branches of a pear tree. South African beetles dig narrow tunnels of approximately 20 cm below the surface of the pat. Some surface-dwelling beetles, including a South African species, cut perfectly-shaped balls from the pat, which are rolled away and attached to the bases of plants.

In the cooler environments of the state of Victoria, the large French species (2.5 cms long), is matched with smaller (half this size), temperate-climate Spanish species. The former are slow to recover from the winter cold and produce only one or two generations of offspring from late spring until autumn. The latter, which multiply rapidly in early spring, produce two to five generations annually. The South African ball-rolling species, being a sub-tropical beetle, prefers the climate of northern and coastal New South Wales where it commonly works with the South African tunneling species. 材料精读 · 内容与词句

这部分把保护问题扩展到栖息地、跨境迁徙、疾病和气候的相互作用，再介绍生态系统恢复合作及数量回升。结尾同时保留积极趋势与持续风险；now、今年和几年前都以原文写作时点为准。

原文片段 · 1

Another threat to the survival of the saiga is loss of habitat, as a result of agricultural expansion and human settlement. Physical barriers such as railways, pipelines and fences can block the seasonal migration routes of this transboundary species. In the worst cases, herds may starve to death after being trapped.

农业和定居点扩张挤压栖息地，铁路、管道及围栏又会切断迁徙通道。这里不只是栖息面积减少，还包括原有空间无法连通；受困兽群甚至可能饿死。transboundary 说明赛加活动跨越国界，管理边界与动物活动边界并不重合。

原文片段 · 2

Then there is the risk of disease. In 2015, an outbreak of haemorrhagic septicaemia, caused by the normally harmless bacterium Pasteurella multocida, killed over 75% of the global adult saiga population in just three weeks. In 2017, 60% of the Mongolian saiga population - a subspecies found nowhere else in the world - was killed by a virus that spilled over from livestock. These so-called mass mortality events represent an unpredictable and serious threat to the species.

两次短期大量死亡说明疾病风险的突然性。2015年的病菌平常无害，却引发严重疫情；2017年蒙古亚种又受到从家畜传播来的病毒影响。normally harmless 并不表示永远无害，spilled over 描述病原从一个动物群体传播到另一个群体。

原文片段 · 3

Climate change poses a further threat. Although well adapted to cold winters and hot summers, saiga struggle to cope with temperature extremes and unpredictable fluctuations in climate. Experts believe that unusually warm weather may have triggered the 2015 mass mortality event. The steppe region has also become increasingly arid in recent years, and many of the smaller streams that the species normally depended on have dried up and vanished.

能适应常见的寒冬与炎夏，不等于能承受所有极端温度和不规则波动。专家把异常暖天气视为2015年大量死亡的可能诱因，may have triggered 保留了推测程度。干旱和溪流消失则构成另一条影响路径，涉及动物可获得的水源。

原文片段 · 4

Recent efforts to save the saiga have been spearheaded by the Altyn Dala Conservation Initiative, a project led by the Association for the Conservation of Biodiversity of Kazakhstan, working in partnership with the Kazakh government's Committee for Forestry and Wildlife, Frankfurt Zoological Society and Fauna and Flora, an international conservation charity. Its purpose is to protect and restore Kazakhstan's steppe, semi-desert and desert ecosystems and the many species they support, including the critically endangered saiga. In 2022 the United Nations recognised the initiative as a World Restoration Flagship project, an accolade reserved for the ten best examples of large-scale ecosystem restoration around the globe.

保护行动由 Altyn Dala 项目牵头，并与政府和国际组织合作。目标是修复草原、半沙漠与沙漠生态系统及其中多个物种，赛加只是重点之一。联合国在2022年的认可体现项目受到重视，原文没有把奖项等同于某种新增资源。

原文片段 · 5

So, how many saiga are there now? By 2000, the global saiga population had hit an all time low of just 21,000 individuals. There was some recovery in the first decade of the new millennium but this was then crushed by devastating mass mortality events that saw the loss of hundreds of thousands of the species. But thanks to the intervention of the Altyn Dala Conservation Initiative, the most recent episodes in the ongoing story of the saiga have been relatively uplifting. Three years ago, the Ustyurt Plateau population in Kazakhstan experienced its largest mass birth of saiga calves in many years. An aerial census two years ago recorded an estimated 842,000 saiga across Kazakhstan as a whole, and according to an aerial survey earlier this year, the saiga population in Kazakhstan now exceeds 1.9 million. The world's strangest-looking antelope remains critically endangered, but the direction of travel is positive.

数量变化并非一路上升：2000年降到低点，随后恢复又遭大量死亡打断，之后才出现出生增加和航空调查记录的回升。文末 positive 指发展方向向好，remains 则保留当时仍有严重风险的判断。这里的年份、估算与保护等级都属于原文语境，不能直接当作今天的状态。

词语与搭配

loss of habitat

栖息地丧失

habitat 指动物赖以生存的环境；与后文迁徙路线被阻断共同描述生存空间的损害。

spilled over from livestock

从家畜传播过来

spill over 在这里比喻病原跨群体传播；livestock 是家畜总称，不是野生动物。

working in partnership with

与……协作

用于说明组织之间共同开展行动；with 后列举合作方。

the direction of travel is positive

总体发展方向是积极的

travel 在这里是趋势比喻，不指赛加的实际迁徙；并不保证以后不会反复。

句子精读

Although well adapted to cold winters and hot summers, saiga struggle to cope with temperature extremes and unpredictable fluctuations in climate.

赛加虽然很好地适应了寒冷的冬季和炎热的夏季，却难以应对极端温度以及无法预测的气候波动。

Although 后省略了与主句一致的主语和系动词，可理解为 although they are well adapted。主句 struggle to cope with 强调应对困难；两个并列名词短语分别指极端程度和变化的不稳定性。

Its purpose is to protect and restore Kazakhstan's steppe, semi-desert and desert ecosystems and the many species they support, including the critically endangered saiga.

它的目的是保护并修复哈萨克斯坦的草原、半沙漠和沙漠生态系统，以及这些生态系统支持生存的众多物种，其中包括当时处于极危状态的赛加。

Its 指保护项目。protect and restore 是并列目的动作；they support 修饰 species，they 回指 ecosystems。including 表示赛加包含在多个受益物种之中，而不是项目唯一保护对象。

working in partnership with

与……共同合作

用于写作：过度捕捞涉及跨界鱼群，原文跨境物种保护中的机构协作与共享海域监管高度吻合。

protect and restore

保护并修复

protect 强调避免进一步破坏，restore 强调恢复已经受损的状态；并列时应同时存在预防与修复需要。

用于写作：可用于说明限制捕捞的生态目标，并与题目中的渔业生计相衔接。

原文片段 · 1Dar es Salaam in Tanzania is one of the fastest growing cities in Africa. Its population has increased eightfold since 1980 and swells by half a million people every year. United Nations projections anticipate it will become a megacity within seven years as its population passes 10 million, reaching 13.4 million by 2035. Daniel Hoornweg for the Global Cities Institute forecasts the city could be home to an incredible 73.7 million people by 2100.

原文片段 · 2Today, four out of five of its people live in single-storey informal settlements on the spreading edges of the city, where the journey to and from the centre regularly takes over two hours. It can be longer if rain turns the dirt roads to mud.

原文片段 · 3Even in the middle of the day, traffic frequently slows to a stop without warning. It is not unusual for cars and minibuses to queue for 20 minutes at a key intersection. A single suburban rail line serves residents in a few areas to the south but is tiny in the context of the wider city. Outside the centre many rely on boda boda (motorbike taxis) to navigate the narrow side streets and potholed mud roads that make up much of the metropolis. Their safety record is scandalous.

原文片段 · 4Dar es Salaam's reliance on four arterial roads into the city is a legacy of the colonial government that planned the city at the start of the 20th century to cater for a population of 35,000. Most of the current growth is made up of young people arriving from the countryside to find work, and as the population has exploded, Dar es Salaam has grown around those four highways. Nearly all the expansion is happening on the periphery, and nearly all takes place informally without any agreed strategy.

原文片段 · 5But Dar es Salaam is pinning its hopes on a solution that could offer a different model for Africa's megacities, giving them an alternative to a future controlled by the private car. Unlike many cities on the continent, Dar es Salaam isn't trying to build a metro. It has chosen a less exciting but cheaper and more achievable method: the bus.

核对原答案页

材料精读 · 内容与词句

文章用人口增长、外围低密度扩张与旧道路格局解释达累斯萨拉姆的出行困境，再引出选择快速公交的背景。人口预测与现实记录分开呈现；公交被认为更便宜、更可实现，并非已经解决全部交通问题。

原文片段 · 1

Dar es Salaam in Tanzania is one of the fastest growing cities in Africa. Its population has increased eightfold since 1980 and swells by half a million people every year. United Nations projections anticipate it will become a megacity within seven years as its population passes 10 million, reaching 13.4 million by 2035. Daniel Hoornweg for the Global Cities Institute forecasts the city could be home to an incredible 73.7 million people by 2100.

人口已经增长八倍是过去到原文当下的变化；未来成为千万人口城市，以及2035年、2100年的规模则是不同来源的预测。anticipate、forecasts 和 could 标出预测性质。开头的作用是让后面的交通需求放在急速扩张的城市规模里理解。

原文片段 · 2

Today, four out of five of its people live in single-storey informal settlements on the spreading edges of the city, where the journey to and from the centre regularly takes over two hours. It can be longer if rain turns the dirt roads to mud.

大部分居民住在不断向外扩展的单层非正规住区，往返中心耗时很长；雨水还会把土路变成泥路。空间距离和道路条件一起影响通勤。informal settlements 描述缺少正规规划等条件的住区，不能简单理解为居民随意居住。

原文片段 · 3

Even in the middle of the day, traffic frequently slows to a stop without warning. It is not unusual for cars and minibuses to queue for 20 minutes at a key intersection. A single suburban rail line serves residents in a few areas to the south but is tiny in the context of the wider city. Outside the centre many rely on boda boda (motorbike taxis) to navigate the narrow side streets and potholed mud roads that make up much of the metropolis. Their safety record is scandalous.

拥堵并不限于上下班时段，现有铁路覆盖也很有限。摩托车出租能穿过狭窄街道，却伴随很差的安全表现。段落展示居民面对的是速度、覆盖与安全的多重约束，而不仅是有没有某一种交通工具。

原文片段 · 4

Dar es Salaam's reliance on four arterial roads into the city is a legacy of the colonial government that planned the city at the start of the 20th century to cater for a population of 35,000. Most of the current growth is made up of young people arriving from the countryside to find work, and as the population has exploded, Dar es Salaam has grown around those four highways. Nearly all the expansion is happening on the periphery, and nearly all takes place informally without any agreed strategy.

四条主干道来自为小得多的人口设计的殖民时期规划。后来大量年轻人进城找工作，城市围绕旧路向边缘扩张，却缺少共同策略。legacy 指过去制度或规划留下的长期影响；旧骨架承受新规模，解释了前面出行问题的结构背景。

原文片段 · 5

But Dar es Salaam is pinning its hopes on a solution that could offer a different model for Africa's megacities, giving them an alternative to a future controlled by the private car. Unlike many cities on the continent, Dar es Salaam isn't trying to build a metro. It has chosen a less exciting but cheaper and more achievable method: the bus.

But 将叙述转向当地希望采用的方案：快速公交可能提供一种不由私家车主导的发展路径。作者把公交与地铁比较，强调成本与可实现性，而不是把技术是否令人兴奋作为首要标准。could offer 保留了方案潜力尚待实现的意味。

informal settlements

非正规住区

城市研究中描述未完整纳入正规规划或基础设施体系的居住区域；不要直接等同于所有低收入社区。

to cater for a population of

为某一规模的人口提供服务

cater for 不只表示提供餐饮，这里指规划满足人口需求。

on the periphery

在城市边缘

the periphery 与中心相对，可用于描述城市扩张的空间方向。

pinning its hopes on

pin one's hopes on 后接计划或方案，带有期待色彩，不能代替对成效的实际证明。

句子精读

Today, four out of five of its people live in single-storey informal settlements on the spreading edges of the city, where the journey to and from the centre regularly takes over two hours.

在作者叙述时，这座城市五分之四的居民住在不断向外扩展的城市边缘的单层非正规住区，从那里往返市中心经常需要两个多小时。

its 指达累斯萨拉姆。主干是 people live in settlements，single-storey 描述房屋形态，on the spreading edges 补充所在位置。where 回接这些外围地点，说明居民从该处出行的耗时。

But Dar es Salaam is pinning its hopes on a solution that could offer a different model for Africa's megacities, giving them an alternative to a future controlled by the private car.

但达累斯萨拉姆正把希望寄托在一个可能为非洲超大城市提供不同发展模式的方案上，让这些城市有机会选择另一条道路，而不是走向由私家车主导的未来。
